name: Harth
source: Harth, the main character of the story, is an orphan who never knew his parents. In spite of his situation, he has managed to thrive through his own hard work and the help of his friends. Harth shares a small, slightly run-down dwelling on the outskirts of town with his closest friend Eryn. Harth has very little but makes a modest living with Eryn by working together to gather food, trap small game, catch fish, and run errands for their friends in town. Lately he has begun to experience a strange recurring dream. What fate awaits Harth as the world he knows begins to change?
